next.reason: §2023:14.9.5.4 GR3 repeats both sentences: the program 'ceases to have any logical relationship to the run unit in which the CANCEL statement appears' and is in its initial state when called again; §2023:14.6.2.3.2 rule 3 places static data in the initial state on the first activation 'after the execution of a CANCEL statement referencing the program'. Dropping 'explicit or implicit' changes nothing: 2023's implicit cancels are CANCEL statements (§2023:14.9.18.4 GR2 'an implicit CANCEL statement').
